title: Item:Soul Gem: Dragon
wikitext:
[[File:Soul Gem - Dragon.png|thumb|Item description]]
'''Soul Gem: Dragon''' can be obtained by casting [[Trap the Soul]] spell on a [[Pseudodragon]] (regular Dragons are always at least Red-named, and therefore immune.) The Strong version of this Soul Gem is used to craft unbound shards of [[Bane (enchantment)|Dragon Bane]].
